description: ONE row (Hospitality, booking + calendar + state-change), full 5-stage chain, dispatched on AWS Bedrock. The time-grid shape: a calendar/floor layout rather than a table, so it exercises responsive breakpoints and date anchoring far harder than a list-and-detail brief does.

rows.prompt: Build the host-stand console for Verdello, a 14-table Italian restaurant. Pages: Tonight (service timeline), Reservation Detail via #/reservation/:id, Floor Plan (table-state list), Waitlist, Guests, Settings. Tonight lists reservations (time, party name, covers, table, occasion, status Booked/Seated/Finished/No-show) with a service-period filter (5:00 / 6:30 / 8:00 seatings) and party-name search. Reservation Detail shows guest notes and allergy flags with 'Seat party' and 'No-show' actions that update the status on Tonight and flip the table's state on the Floor Plan. Waitlist has a 'Convert to reservation' action that inserts a row into Tonight. Guest history counts must match Tonight's data. Realistic Italian-restaurant names, tables T1-T14, covers, times.
